title: Violation; penalties.
bodyText: Any person who violates section 486H-10.4 shall be assessed a civil penalty of $1,000 per day for each violation.
bodyHtml: §486H-10.5  Violation; penalties.  Any person who violates section 486H-10.4 shall be assessed a civil penalty of $1,000 per day for each violation. [L 1995, c 238, §1; am L 2008, c 19, §60]
